items.content_text: - **NBA sportsbook prop bet limits do not cover Kalshi and Polymarket prediction markets** — The NBA has worked with partner sportsbooks to remove certain wagers, including same-player under parlays and opening-tip bets, after last season's gambling scandals. items.title: JPMorgan Democrat Factor rises about 20 percent as Polymarket prices a Democratic sweep near 65 percent
items.content_text: - **JPMorgan Democrat Factor rises about 20 percent as Polymarket prices a Democratic sweep near 65 percent** — JPMorgan's Democrat Factor, a beta-neutral pair trade built to track Democratic election odds, is up roughly 20 percent since August while the S and P 500 rose about 2.6 percent. The move tracks prediction market pricing that puts the chance of Democrats taking both chambers of Congress at roughly 65 percent on Polymarket.
